text:
Nina (CSM): Quick heads-up — we've confirmed a partial tokenization error that degraded embeddings for ~12 EU trial tenants starting 03/20 14:10 UTC. Drafting customer outreach, want alignment on credits + office hours.
Maria (CS Ops): Thanks. Are we sure it's only embeddings, not generation?
Lee (Support): Confirmed: 502/503 spike for embeddings endpoint only, generation unaffected. Logs show malformed token counts for long non-latin strings.
Jordan (SE): Root cause looks like an upstream tokenizer lib bump rolled in earlier today on the private edge. Reverting will fix within the hour but need to coordinate rollout.
Nina (CSM): Suggested comms: short apology, impact, ETA to full fix, workaround (shorten queries or use hosted endpoint), offer office hours, and a one-time credit. Draft below — please edit.
Sam (Sales): Renewal risk on 3 of those tenants is medium-high. Recommend conservative credit: $500 credit + 1 office-hours session per affected enterprise. Need Ops sign-off.
Maria (CS Ops): Proposed credit calc: trials -> $100 credit, SMB -> $250, enterprise -> $500. For contractual accounts, escalate to AM for tailored remediation.
Lee (Support): Outreach template (copy-paste):
```
Hi <Customer name>,
We’re sorry — we detected degraded embeddings affecting some queries since 03/20 14:10 UTC. We’ve identified the cause (tokenizer version mismatch) and are reverting the change. Expected full restoration within ~60 minutes.
Workaround: If you can, shorten embeddings inputs to <4k characters or switch to the hosted embeddings endpoint: https://api.redwood.dev/embeddings-hosted
We’re offering a one-time account credit and an optional office-hours session to review your integration. Reply if you’d like us to book a slot.
Apologies for the disruption — Nina, Customer Success
```
Jordan (SE): +1. Also include: if they hit any 5xx for embeddings within that window we'll flag for manual re-sync and offer assistance with re-indexing.
Nina (CSM): Good call — add: "If you received errors, we’ll help reprocess affected items; reply with sample IDs or timestamps."
OpsBot: Incident 2024-EMB-472 logged, priority: P2. Rollback in progress on EU edge; expected complete 3523456815.
Maria (CS Ops): Action items: 1) Nina to send outbound to affected list (draft ready) — targeting 14:35 UTC. 2) Jordan to finish rollback and confirm fix. 3) Lee to prepare re-sync playbook and reindex offer. 4) Sam to flag high-risk renewals for AM outreach.
Sam (Sales): I'll ping AMs for the 3 at-risk accounts and prepare a short exec note.
Lee (Support): Re-sync playbook snippet: `POST /v1/embeddings/resync {\"tenant_id\": \"<id>\", \"ids\": [..]}` — run with support token; we can schedule runs during off-peak.
Nina (CSM): Draft outbound sent to #cs-drafts for quick review. Will include the credit tiers and a link to schedule 30-min office hours. If you have wording tweaks, drop them now. :pray:
Maria (CS Ops): Fine to send. Approving credit tiers. Please bcc AMs for enterprise customers.
Jordan (SE): Rollback completed — metrics trending back to baseline, monitoring for 15m.
Nina (CSM): Sending outreach now. Will open a follow-up thread per-account for tailored remediation/credits. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
